name: ingest-genome-annotations-pipeline
description: Download and ingest genome annotations GTF files from Ensembl ftp server

parameters.name: sdk_container_image
parameters.label: Worker SDK Container Image
parameters.helpText: Container image URI used for the Python SDK harness on Dataflow workers. This must contain your packaged pipelines and dependencies.

parameters.name: experiments
parameters.label: Experiments
parameters.helpText: Comma-separated Dataflow experiments. For custom containers, Runner v2 is required. Use 'use_runner_v2' for batch.

parameters.name: pipeline
parameters.label: Pipeline Identifier
parameters.helpText: Which pipeline to launch (required by the dispatcher)

parameters.name: index
parameters.label: Elasticsearch Index
parameters.helpText: Name of the index to query in Elasticsearch

parameters.name: taxonomy_path
parameters.label: Taxonomy validated file path (GCS)
parameters.helpText: GCS path prefix for the file with validated taxonomy

parameters.name: output
parameters.label: Output Path (GCS)
parameters.helpText: GCS path prefix for output files

parameters.name: gtf_staging_path
parameters.label: Path to the GTF staging directory
parameters.helpText: GCS path prefix for staging of GTF files download
